data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** PLACEHOLDER_SHA

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per `skills/brainstorm/prompts/cross-epic-scan.md`, Step 2.25 dispatches `dso:cross-epic-interaction-classifier` (haiku tier) sub-agents in batches of 20 to classify interactions between the new epic and all open/in-progress epics. The approval gate (`phases/approval-gate.md`) HARD-GATE requires sub-agent dispatch and records inline triage as SKIPPED, blocking the gate until user authorization.

#### Actual Behavior

The brainstorm orchestrator (main session) scanned the `ticket list-epics` output inline and pattern-matched overlaps (4e55-a6ba, 5d6e-86a9, 2fa0-a2d9, jira-dig-1432) without dispatching any sub-agents. This was recorded as `cross_epic=SKIPPED:inline-triage-only` at the approval gate. User flagged this as a recurring problem — the orchestrator repeatedly substitutes inline reasoning for required sub-agent dispatch.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Skill:** /dso:brainstorm
* **Phase:** Phase 2 Step 2.25 (Cross-Epic Interaction Scan)
* **Contract:** skills/brainstorm/prompts/cross-epic-scan.md
* **Gate:** phases/approval-gate.md HARD-GATE (SCRUTINY line)
data.title: [brainstorm]: Cross-epic scan executed inline by orchestrator instead of dispatching haiku classifier sub-agents -> SKIPPED signal at approval gate
